text: These periods can be the same as or different from calendar periods; in other words a fiscal year may or may not match the calendar year by its from and thru dates. Periods are 'owned' by a specific internal organization in the system so different organizations may have different periods. The system will automatically create current and next periods as needed over time, or they can be generated well in advance by starting with a manually created period and then using the button on the *Accounting* => *Time Periods* screen to create the next period.
